archetypes.name: state-key-lifecycle
archetypes.rationale: The plan introduces CI_FIX_REBASE_PENDING as a run-scoped state key but does not specify its persistence mechanism, which is a concrete implementation gap in a Bash script with sub-process calls.
archetypes.prompt_body: Examine how the plan proposes to store and clear CI_FIX_REBASE_PENDING and compare against how other run-scoped state keys are managed in scripts/ship-pr.sh and scripts/session-env.sh. Check whether the key survives sub-process boundaries (calls to run_rebase_rebump, _verify_failed_jobs_locally) and whether the 'clear after successful push' instruction is durable across early-exit paths. Verify the plan's claim that CI_FIX_REBASE_PENDING persists to force-with-lease on retry when re-verify fails mid-path — trace whether that state is readable after a sub-process exit. Check whether the plan's failure-mode #1 (re-verify fails after deferred rebase) maps the CI_FIX_REBASE_PENDING flag to a concrete storage mechanism that survives the outer _max_fix loop's next iteration. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: test-list-fidelity
archetypes.rationale: The plan's Testing Strategy names scripts/test-ci-status.sh as needing verification but the file is absent from both the Files to modify/create list and scope-files.txt, a discrepancy that may leave the ci-status.sh delegation change untested.
archetypes.prompt_body: Cross-check every file named in the Testing Strategy section of the plan against the Files to modify/create list and the provided scope-files.txt. Identify any test files listed in the strategy that are absent from the modification list (specifically scripts/test-ci-status.sh after ci-status.sh's BEHIND_COUNT delegation to ci-behind-count.sh), and assess whether those omissions represent a real regression risk. Verify that the Makefile changes described (harness-timer.sh wiring, shard assignment to a test-harnesses-N group) are specific enough to implement without ambiguity, and check that an existing shard pattern in Makefile supports the described wiring. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: waterfall-semantic-shift
archetypes.rationale: The plan re-keys the first-fixer-non-health shortcut from the literal cursor tier to the first iteration of the rotated waterfall, a behavioral change whose failure-mode implications across all rotation offsets are not fully traced.
archetypes.prompt_body: Examine the current first-fixer-non-health logic at scripts/ship-pr.sh lines 1907-1915 and determine precisely what changes when the shortcut is re-keyed from the literal 'cursor' check to 'first iteration of this waterfall'. Assess whether the bail-early semantics remain safe when claude or codex leads the rotated order — for example, if start_attempt=2 so claude leads and returns a non-health error, does the plan correctly classify this as ci-local-unfixable. Check whether any callers or downstream state machines (run_evaluate_failure, ci-decide.sh) depend on the assumption that the first-fixer-non-health path fires only when cursor is the first tier, and whether the plan's 'consciously-updated semantic' claim is tested by any of the proposed test-ship-pr.sh cases. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
